The '''E-11s sniper rifle''' was a modified [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and was the standard issue weapon for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]].

==Description==
[[File:E11s_sniper_rifle-EtU.png|thumb|left|270px|E-11s sniper rifle]]
The modified [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] E-11s [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] had a high-powered scope, allowing it to be used as a sniper weapon. In exchange for long-range power, however, the E-11s could only fire 6 shots before reloading.<ref name="BF I guide" /> The rifle could withstand any kind of weather and seldom malfunctioned.

==History==
The E-11s saw use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] in battlefronts throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="BF I" />

==Behind the scenes==
The use of the real-world MG34 machine gun as a ''[[Star Wars]]'' weapon originally came in the form of the [[DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle]] that first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. The appearance was later used to fill the appearance of the weapons used by the sniper units of both the Republic and Empire in the [[Star Wars Battlefront (series)|''Star Wars: Battlefront'']] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] series, and given the titles of [[DC-15x sniper rifle/Legends|DC-15x]] and E-11s, respectively.
